title: onetake continuous-take launch films
what_it_does: Skill that designs the boundary between beats so something on screen carries into the next beat, with a probe script that checks continuity per boundary; 11 case films.
when_to_use: Reference for a one-camera launch style; our seam ledger is the permissive route to the same goal.
